description: Complete MPR109, including all printed intermediate claims and a self-contained finite flow theorem

claims.claim: Every partial-order, upper-set and coupling-support definition; necessity
Complete list of upper sets and all inequalities in109(a)
Explicit valid three-state coupling and comparison with the chain case108
Every lower-set/complement argument and zero/full boundary in109(b)
Precise2n+2-vertex network, capacities and flow/marginal equivalence
Compactness, maximum existence, residual reachability and exact cut-capacity identity
Both directions of the supplied blocking-pair criterion, including real/zero capacities
Every corrected closure inclusion and probability inequality
Exact two-state witness and repair for wrong target vertex F171
Exact positive-weight counterexample and closure repair for F172
Complete corrected existence theorem, separately scoped bibliography omissions
